ov: البعد الآخر (الإنجليزية: The Blind Side) هو فيلم درامي رياضي أمريكي أُصدر في عام 2009، كتبه وأخرجه جون لي هانكوك، القصة مقتبسة من كتاب ( البعد الآخر: تطور اللعبة ) والذي أصدر في عام 2006 وهو من تأليف مايكل لويس ومبني على قصة حقيقية، وتتناول أحداث الفيلم قصة شاب فقير لم يتلقَ قدراً كافياً من التعليم ينضم لأحد برامج كرة القدم الأمريكية، حيث يبدأ في تحقيق مستقبل أكاديمي ورياضي ناجح بدوري كرة القدم الأمريكية، الفيلم من بطولة ساندرا بولوك، تيم ماكجراو وكوينتون آرون. فازت ساندرا بولوك بأوسكار أفضل ممثلة عن دورها في هذا الفيلم.
plotEn:
Michael "Big Mike" Oher is a 17-year old who's been in foster care in Tennessee due to his biological mother's drug addiction. Every time he's placed in a new home, he tries to return to her. While living on a friend's couch, his friend's father notices Michael's size and athleticism and arranges for Burt Cotton, the football coach of Wingate Christian School, to enroll Michael despite his poor academic record. 
Michael is befriended by a younger student named Sean Tuohy Jr. ("SJ"). SJ's mother, Leigh Anne, is a strong-minded interior designer and the wife of wealthy businessman Sean Sr. Michael receives news that his father has died in an accident. Leigh Anne and Sean notice Michael picking discarded food from the bleachers after a volleyball game. The evening before Thanksgiving, Leigh Anne notices Michael walking alone without adequate clothing. When she learns he plans to spend the night outside the school, she offers him shelter in the Tuohy home and asks him to Thanksgiving dinner with her family. 
Leigh Anne unsuccessfully tries to return Michael to his biological mother's house, but it has an eviction notice posted. Michael becomes a member of the Tuohy family. Leigh Anne's friends suggest Collins, Leigh Anne's daughter, might not be safe around Michael. Collins rejects the notion. When Leigh Anne attempts to become Michael's legal guardian, she learns he was taken from his drug-addicted birth mother when he was seven; nobody knows her whereabouts. 
Michael scores poo
